opener:
Hi Better in Bed team,

The 14 October gadgets episode got me thinking about a follow-up angle: a lot of listeners track their sleep and then stress over the score. We're building Vybe, a screenless overnight band that reads heart rate, HRV and sleep timing and compares each night to the wearer's own baseline, not a population number, so there's no screen to check at 3 a.m.

If a 'how to read your own sleep data without obsessing' episode is ever on the list, I'd be glad to be a source or guest, at no cost. Happy to talk here: https://calendly.com/jeremy-vybe/30min
